verdict.rationale: Anytype ships its own MCP server, documented as 'enabling AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Anytype's API through natural language'. It also ships an open-source agents skill that lets assistants like Claude Code or Cursor read, search, and modify Objects, and run scripts for bulk edits. Natural-language operation still requires an external AI client sitting on the local API, with no built-in in-app command interface. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works reliably, documentation of which operations are covered by natural language.
